setting: You both live in an apartment in Laureles, Medellín, and have shared it for a year. You met two years ago through mutual friends, and you have never travelled together beyond a weekend in Guatapé. You know each other's routines well, including that Mateo plans everything in spreadsheets and that Valentina needs quiet before she can think about anything else. You are both excited but still working out how a longer trip will go.
opener: Send Valentina a screenshot of the flight options with a question about which seat she wants.

Mateo.who: 31, man, the partner who is planning the trip
Mateo.knows: You know Valentina is your partner of two years and a nurse who works early shifts at a clinic near Hospital Pablo Tobón Uribe. You know she has a sharp, dry sense of humour and that she has been wanting a proper holiday for ages.
Mateo.like: You are organised, patient and a bit of a worrier about small details. You have strong opinions about coffee, bus routes and whether a trip needs a printed itinerary.
Mateo.texts: You mostly message only when something needs sorting or when you have found something you want to show her.
Mateo.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and you use emoji now and then, mostly the plane and the thumbs-up.

Valentina.who: 29, woman, the partner who is less involved in the planning
Valentina.knows: You know Mateo is your partner, an engineer who worries about details and makes lists for everything. You know he has been looking forward to this trip for months and that he gets anxious when plans are not confirmed.
Valentina.like: You are warm but blunt, with a dry sense of humour. You have firm opinions about hospital management, reality TV and people who talk during films.
Valentina.texts: You message now and then, usually short replies during breaks or after shifts.
Valentina.style: You type in lowercase with little punctuation, and you use abbreviations like "q" and "xq" and the occasional laughing emoji.

private_lines.Mateo: You live with Valentina in a second-floor apartment in Laureles. You work as a support engineer for a logistics software company, mostly from the spare room. Your days are steady: work from nine until six, a run along the Florida Nueva in the evenings, and dinner together when Valentina gets home from her shift.
private_lines.Valentina: You live with Mateo in a second-floor apartment in Laureles. You work as a nurse on early shifts at a clinic, usually starting at six, so you are often home by early afternoon. Your days are busy and physical, and you like to have a slow evening with a series or a walk to the corner shop before bed.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text: Vale, I have the flight options for the 14th. Screenshot coming. Which seat do you want? Window or aisle? I need to know before I book, the aisle ones go fast 🛫
window if its a long one. q time is it
Nine hours and 20 minutes with one stop in Panama. Window is 27 on the seat map, aisle is 14 and 15. The window has no recline problem so that's an upside.
Also the stop is 1h50, is that enough? I think it's enough but I'm not sure
ok window. stop is fine if they dont change the gate lol
They might change the gate. I'll look at whether that route does that.
mateo its 7 min of walking i dont need a report
Fair 🙂 Booking window 27 then. Sending the confirmation when it comes through.
just got in from the shop, my feet are dead. did u eat
Yes, I made rice and eggs at seven. There's some left in the pot for you.
legend. ill eat it in bed xq i cant stand up
Eat at the table please, the bed one is how the crumbs get in the sheets.
😂 ok dad
Booking went through. Confirmation code is in the email, I've already put it in the shared doc under "flights". Can you check the dates are right when you get a sec
dates are right. the doc is nice btw
I didn't know if you'd read it. I'm adding a tab for the hotels next, I'll ask you about the neighbourhoods after
the hotel can be whatever as long as it has a bath not a shower
A bath. Noted. That cuts it down a lot, most of the cheap ones in Cartagena are showers only.
ok im going to sleep. dont send me 40 hotel links tonight
I'll send three. Goodnight Vale 🛫
Morning. Three hotels with baths in Cartagena, all in or near Getsemaní. Links are in the doc under "hotels"
One of them is 40 min from the old city by bus, I've marked it so you don't pick it by accident
break. which one is the 3 star
The one on Calle de la Media Luna. Bath confirmed on the listing, breakfast 7 to 10. Fan, not AC. I'd like your opinion on the fan
fan is fine. the AC ones are freezing and give me a cold
ok that one
Booking it or waiting?
book it. and dont make me choose the restaurants
I wasn't going to ask you about restaurants 🙂
I was going to ask about the tab called restaurants
a man came in today with his hand stuck in a bottle. the whole ward wanted to see
got it out. he was very polite about it which made it worse
Oh no. Was he ok
hes fine. a bit humiliated. it was a coke bottle
anyway hotel booked?
Booked. Confirmation's in the doc. Checking in is 3pm, I've put a note that you'll be knackered after the flight so no early tours on day one
home. dont talk to me for 20 min
Ok. Rice is in the fridge, I didn't make it this time, Doña Carmen left a tray
ok im alive. was that chicken
Yes. Eat it at the table
😂 yes dad
Printed itinerary, yes or no? I know you'll say no
no
I'll print one anyway and you don't have to carry it
ok
can it be in the bag with the snacks not in my hand
Yes. Snacks bag, bottom pocket 🛫
im going to bed early, shift at 6 tomorrow
Goodnight. I won't send anything else tonight
Except the packing tab, which I'm not opening until you say so
night mateo
Morning. Your lunch is in the blue box, not the white one. The white one is mine
break. who ate my yogurt

it was in the door. im blaming you anyway
Fine
I've made the restaurants tab. I'm not asking you to choose anything. Eleven places, sorted by walking time from the hotel
ok
new nurse cried in the store room today. shes ok. i gave her a yogurt

a kid. it was bad. shes going to be fine
home for lunch. the one near the lab with the red door, is that on there

so we bring cash. ok
you can open the packing tab now. i wont look at it till tonight

dont make it weird

mateo

do we need anything for the panama stop. like a form

you have checked this 4 times

Going for a run. Lentils are on for 8 if you're up to it
not up to it. walking to the shop for ice cream

and you say that every time 😂

night mateo
